signatureAbility.signatureDescription: Shutdown defenders have the talent to erase receivers from the game. When they enter the zone, their coverage is tighter and interceptions are more frequent on contested catches.
Defenders with this ability force more catch knockouts and react quicker in any mid-field zone coverage, less than 20 yards from the LoS inside the numbers and 10-20 outside.
Defenders with this ability generally react much faster to receiver cut moves when in man coverage
Defenders with this ability force more catch tackle knockouts in man-to-man versus short routes less than 10 yards from LoS
Defenders with this ability have higher chance to catch uncontested interceptions, and they have unlimited stamina on the return (until using a special move or breaking a tackle).
The best physical receivers don't just come down with the ball, they carry it home. When they enter the zone, they are nearly guaranteed to break their first post-catch tackle.
Receivers with this ability catch more consistently while catching passes 10-20 yards from the LoS, inside the numbers
Receivers with this ability catch more consistently while catching passes 20+ yards from the LoS, inside the numbers
Ballcarriers with this ability have more powerful truck and stiff arm animations.

signatureAbility.signatureActivationDescription: Make consecutive passes for 5+ yards in air
signatureAbility.signatureDescription: Elite quarterbacks are molded by endless hours of film study. When they enter the zone, they have full vision of the secondary's defensive coverage before the snap.
Passers with this ability improve the catching prowess of all running backs who are open on pass plays.
Passers with this ability have faster passing animations when they are throwing under pressure
Passers with this ability have perfect accuracy on all lob or touch passes (except high/low and cross-body throws).
Passers with this ability have perfect accuracy on all throws inside the numbers (except on high/low throws).
The most physical coverage defenders prevent catches from happening even when their target has hands on the ball. When they enter the zone, they are nearly guaranteed knockouts.
Defenders with this ability force more catch knockouts and react quicker in any flat zone coverage, less than 10 yards from the LoS and outside the hash marks.
Defenders with this ability have higher chance to catch uncontested interceptions, and they have unlimited stamina on the return (until using a special move or breaking a tackle).
Defenders with this ability generally react much faster to receiver cut moves when in man coverage and outside the numbers
Defenders with this ability have higher chance to catch uncontested interceptions, and they have unlimited stamina on the return (until using a special move or breaking a tackle).
Defenders with this ability can still tackle effectively while trying to strip the football.
Defenders with this ability are rarely faked out by ballcarrier moves (and cannot be faked out when user-controlled).
Defenders with this ability can reach out of engaged blocks to tackle or sack nearby ballcarriers.
Defenders with this ability can still tackle effectively while trying to strip the football.
Ballcarriers with this ability retain more of their forward momentum during tackles while travelling at high speeds.
Ballcarriers with this ability have more powerful truck animations.
Players with this ability will recover from the effects of fatigue at an increased rate between plays.
Defenders with this ability use faster run shed moves for a better chance at shedding blocks against outside zone plays.
Defenders with this ability can reach out of engaged blocks to tackle or sack nearby ballcarriers.
